title: The Ten Commandments Restated

questions.question: Where did God make the covenant Moses restated?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:2 (ESV): "The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb."

questions.question: What was the first commandment Moses repeated?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:7 (ESV): "You shall have no other gods before me."

questions.question: Why was the Sabbath to be kept holy?
options: To honor creation and deliverance from Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: To honor creation and deliverance from Egypt
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:15 (ESV): "You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt... therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day."

questions.question: What did the people ask after hearing God’s voice?
options: For Moses to speak for God
questions.correctAnswer: For Moses to speak for God
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:27 (ESV): "Go near and hear all that the LORD our God will say, and speak to us... and we will hear and do it."

questions.question: What did God promise for obedience to His commandments?
options: Long life and prosperity in the land
questions.correctAnswer: Long life and prosperity in the land
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:33 (ESV): "that you may live, and that it may go well with you, and that you may live long in the land..."

questions.question: Who did God make this covenant with?
options: With us, who are all of us here alive today
questions.correctAnswer: With us, who are all of us here alive today
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:3 (ESV): "Not with our fathers did the Lord make this covenant, but with us, who are all of us here alive today."

questions.question: What did Moses do while the Lord spoke the covenant?
options: Stood between the Lord and the people
questions.correctAnswer: Stood between the Lord and the people
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:5 (ESV): "I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to declare to you the word of the Lord..."

questions.question: The Sabbath command says you shall not do any work, nor which of your animals?
options: Ox, donkey, or any of your livestock
questions.correctAnswer: Ox, donkey, or any of your livestock
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:14 (ESV): "...you, or your son... or your ox or your donkey or any of your livestock..."

questions.question: Honor your father and mother so that what may happen?
options: Your days may be long and it may go well with you
questions.correctAnswer: Your days may be long and it may go well with you
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:16 (ESV): "...that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you in the land..."

questions.question: What neighborly sins are forbidden?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:20 (ESV): "And you shall not bear false witness against your neighbor."

questions.question: Where did God write these commandments?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:22 (ESV): "And he wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me."

questions.question: Why were the people afraid to hear God's voice anymore?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:25 (ESV): "Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us."

questions.question: Who approached Moses after the voice spoke?
options: The heads of the tribes and elders
questions.correctAnswer: The heads of the tribes and elders
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:23 (ESV): "...all the heads of your tribes and your elders came near to me..."

questions.question: What did God wish for the people?
options: That they had such a heart to fear Him always
questions.correctAnswer: That they had such a heart to fear Him always
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:29 (ESV): "Oh that they had such a heart as this always, to fear me and to keep all my commandments..."

questions.question: Which commandment involves "coveting"?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 5:21 (ESV): "And you shall not covet your neighbor's wife... house... field..."

key_verse_text: Oh that they had such a heart as this always, to fear me and to keep all my commandments, that it might go well with them and with their descendants forever! (ESV)
